High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.2886 of 2026, which is the third application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C/430(1) of the BNSS, 2023, for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf appellant.
His first application was dismissed for want of prosecution vide order dated 17.06.2016 and second application was second application was dismissed on merits vide order dated 16.08.2023.

This appeal has been preferred against the judgment dated 21.08.2014 passed by Sessions/Special Judge, POCSO Act, Sagar (M.P.) in S.S.T. No.108/2013, whereby the appellant has been convicted and sentenced as under:
 Conviction U/s.

Fine  
 
 363 of IPC R.I. for 2 years Rs.500/-
 
 
 366 of IPC R.I. for 2 years Rs.500/-
 
 
 376(D) of IPC R.I. for 20 years Rs.2000/-
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted and sentenced appellant.

He further submits that the sentence of co- accused has already been suspended and he has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 27.01.2026 passed in connected Criminal Appeal No.3283 of 2017 and the case of the appellant is similar to that of the co-accused therefore,
seeks parity with the co-accused.
The appellant is in jail since 09.05.2013.
This appeal is of the year 2014 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal 2 CRA-2443-2014 in near future.
He is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by the directions and conditions, which may be imposed by this Court.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be allowed on the ground of parity.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State on the other hand has opposed the application for suspension of sentence and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties as well as on the ground of parity, we are of the opinion that the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant can be considered.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, aforesaid I.A. is allowed.

It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of appellant is hereby suspended and he be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 25.08.2026 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard during pendency of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
(VIVEK KUMAR SINGH) (AJAY KU  JUDGE   SSL Hyalle @ Halke vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154543900/
